title: New shipment, Edit shipment
purpose: Start a shipment for an approved request, or change its ship-to and courier details.
summary: Start a shipment for an approved request, or change its ship-to and courier details.

tasks.title: Start a shipment
steps: Check the [[Recipient]], [[Institution]] and [[Address]], copied from the request.
Add the planned date and courier if known, and select [[Create shipment]]. Contents opens next.

tasks.title: Change the details
steps: Change the fields, give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: A packed shipment can change only its planned date and courier details.
Ship-to details and storage instructions are printed on the manifest.
Courier and tracking number can also be given at dispatch.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. A shipment is started for an approved request only. A draft can change every field; a packed shipment only the planned date and courier details (unpack it to change the rest); a dispatched or cancelled one cannot be edited. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.
Creating a shipment takes you to Contents to choose its specimens.

items.label: Recipient, Institution, Address
items.description: Required. Copied from the investigator and institution for a new shipment; change them when it goes elsewhere. Printed on the manifest.

items.label: Contact
items.description: Optional: the recipient's professional email or phone.

items.label: Courier, Service, Tracking number
items.description: Optional; can also be given at dispatch.

items.label: Storage instructions
items.description: Optional, up to 500 characters, printed on the manifest. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Required when editing, kept in the timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Create shipment records a draft numbered SH-000001 and up. Save changes records the old and new values in the timeline. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
